name: pdf-data-visualization
description: Produces reproducible data figures for final PDF placement with physical-size legibility, source context, and a usable evidence companion. Applies when a report, paper, handout, or exported page requires reliable vector or mixed vector/raster visualization.

contract.what: A source-grounded figure whose final PDF placement preserves readable labels, quantitative geometry, context, and evidence access.
when: The receiving artifact is a PDF report, scientific paper, editorial document, handout, or print-oriented export.
boundaries: The data owner controls meaning; the document owner controls page composition and publication. A plotting backend supplies graphics, while PDF tagging, reading order, accessibility conformance, and production printing retain their own implementation and evidence.
contract.result: A reproducible figure and final-document handoff with fitting dimensions, export settings, caption/source, exact values, and an observed or explicitly pending placement check.

receivingUse.job: The receiving artifact is a PDF report, scientific paper, editorial document, handout, or print-oriented export.
receivingUse.materialResult: A reproducible figure and final-document handoff with fitting dimensions, export settings, caption/source, exact values, and an observed or explicitly pending placement check.
receivingUse.completion: The receiving collaborator can locate the semantic source, work within its boundaries, and recognize the material result.

standing.evidenceMaturity: Repository-maintained portable contract with source-specific, revisable material-use evidence.
standing.wakeTrigger: Material use, human correction, receiving-artifact behavior, or independent evidence changes this route.

transferBoundary: This projection carries repository-local instruction yield. Current intent, repository evidence, and granted tool authority govern each activation.
